title: Repo sync configuration
description: The process environment repo-sync reads: its volume, its limits, and the App credentials it mints fetch tokens with.

HUB_DATA_DIR.description: Absolute mount point of the volume holding mirrors and worktrees. Defaultless: a wrong path rebuilds every mirror silently.

HUB_DATA_MAX_BYTES.description: Total volume cap in bytes. Defaultless: uncapped, the failure is every git fetch breaking at once, not disk full.

HUB_WORKTREE_IDLE_TTL.description: How long an unleased worktree survives before eviction. Typed string: lifecycle is planned and the grammar is unfixed.

HUB_LEASE_TTL.description: Server-side expiry for a worktree lease; must exceed the slowest render. Typed string for the same reason as the TTL above.

HUB_LOCAL_REPO.description: Absolute host directory mounted read-only, for the no-GitHub path. Declared by compose only; production has no host to mount.

GITHUB_APP_ID.description: Numeric id of the GitHub App, used to mint installation tokens. Not a secret, and typed so a client id in this key fails.

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Secret. Mints installation tokens rather than being one, so nothing here outranks it. Never committed, never on the volume.
